headline: RodWave linked up with the Houston Texans for a special visit, touring the team’s facility
body: RodWave linked up with the Houston Texans for a special visit, touring the team’s facility and getting an inside look at what goes on behind the scenes. From stepping into the building to taking in the football atmosphere, it was a full-circle experience connecting two worlds — music and sports. Rod also crossed paths with Texans wide receiver TankDell making the link-up even more special.

#RodWave linked up with the Houston Texans for a special visit, touring the team’s facility and getting an inside look at what goes on behind the scenes. 

From stepping into the building to taking in the football atmosphere, it was a full-circle experience connecting two worlds — music and sports.

Rod also crossed paths with Texans wide receiver #TankDell making the link-up even more special. Both Rod and Tank have roots in Florida, bringing that Florida connection to Houston and creating a natural bond between two stars from the Sunshine State🌴⭐️
